page.overview:
Who is Blade?

Blade is a giant from Elbaph who works as math teacher at the Walrus School.

Blade is a giant with long light hair, a prominent nose, and horns indicative of ancient giant blood. He wears round glasses and has stubble of a mustache and beard. His outfit consists of a dark sleeveless shirt, a dark fur cape, a wide belt, a fur kilt, and fur-lined boots. His legs appear quite muscular.

Blade seems to care for his students' and coworkers' well-being as he prioritized evacuation efforts when the Walrus School was threatened by a monster.

As a giant, Blade has immense physical strength. As a math teacher, he likely possesses extensive knowledge of mathematics.
